title: Attention over Scene Graphs: Indoor Scene Representations Toward CSAI Classification
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and evaluation of a framework for indoor scene classification, specifically for identifying Child Sexual Abuse Imagery (CSAI). While the application domain is of high ethical and legal importance, the study focuses on technical classification metrics like accuracy and recall rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious beliefs, ethical frameworks, or moral reasoning within the models themselves.
